navHint.overview: The location at a glance and the list of what is still missing before it can operate.
navHint.cash: Day closing (Z) with the card terminal reconciliation, the closings so far and the daily cash book.
navHint.location: Location data (name, legal name, address, UID/VAT, languages) and its rules: when a manager must approve, PIN attempts, kitchen alert, printing, receipts, reservations and the local hub.
navHint.floor: Areas of the restaurant (dining room, terrace…) and their tables with seats, shape and QR code.
navHint.devices: POS terminals, handhelds and kitchen displays (KDS): pair them with a code, activate or deactivate them. Also kitchen stations and printers.
navHint.users: Staff: roles (admin, manager, cashier, waiter, kitchen), POS PIN, language and the locations they work at.
navHint.products: Dishes and drinks: price, category, tax category, variants, modifiers, allergens, kitchen station and availability.
navHint.categories: Menu groups (starters, mains, drinks…) and the order they appear in on the POS.
navHint.modifiers: Options added to a product: doneness, side dish, extras with or without a price.
navHint.tax: Swiss VAT (MWST): current rates and which rate each tax category takes, eaten in or taken away.
navHint.customers: Registered guests with their data consent (for invoices from CHF 400, reservations and contact).
navHint.audit: History of sensitive actions: voids, discounts, reopenings, refunds and configuration changes, with who, when and why.
navHint.syncConflicts: Operations made offline that clashed when syncing (e.g. two people changed the same thing). The manager reviews and resolves them.
navHint.supportAccess: Grant or revoke DINOLABS support access to your organization for a limited time.
navHint.apiKeys: Keys to connect other systems (such as Zitas) to the POS API with limited permissions.
navHint.account: Your user: name, password and interface language.
navHint.reports: Sales, VAT, tips, voids and times of a period, plus the exports for accounting, the fiduciary and the archive.
navHint.plan: Your restaurant’s plan, add-ons, usage and monthly price.
navHint.help: Short guides for every role, to read or print.
navHint.inventory: Raw materials, stock and alerts for what is running low.
navHint.recipes: How much of each raw material every dish uses.
